name: api: a macro builds a plate — sketch, boss, cut through, fillets on the vertical edges — with no rebuild errors and the right size and volume
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const run = async (lines) => m.macro.runMacro(lines.join('\n'), { name: 'api-test.mmjs' }); await m.actions.ensureKernel(); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); const r = await run(['await mm.newDocument("part");', 'const s = await mm.sketch("top", [{ rect: [80, 50] }, { circle: [20, 0, 10] }]);', 'await mm.extrude(s, 12, { name: "Base" });', 'const h = await mm.sketch("top", [{ circle: [-20, 0, 8] }]);', 'await mm.cut(h, "through");', 'await mm.fillet(2, (e) => e.type === "LINE" && Math.abs(e.dir[2]) > 0.99 && Math.abs(Math.abs(e.mid[0]) - 40) < 1e-3);', 'const bb = mm.boundingBox();', 'return { features: mm.features().map((f) => f.type), names: mm.features().map((f) => f.name), size: bb.size.map((v) => Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000), errors: mm.errors(), vertical: mm.edges((e) => e.type === "LINE" && Math.abs(e.dir[2]) > 0.99 && Math.abs(Math.abs(e.mid[0]) - 40) < 1e-3 && Math.abs(Math.abs(e.mid[1]) - 25) < 1e-3).length, filleted: mm.feature("Fillet1") ? null : mm.features().filter((f) => f.type === "fillet").length };']); const v = r.value; const vol = m.macro.mm.massProperties ? null : null; return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, err: r.error ?? null, features: v?.features.join(','), base: v?.names.includes('Base'), size: v?.size, errors: v?.errors.length, vertical: v?.vertical, filleted: v?.filleted }); })()

name: api: one undo per call; suppress, rename and delete features; a bad call stops the macro with a clear message and its line
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const run = async (lines) => m.macro.runMacro(lines.join('\n'), { name: 'api-test.mmjs' }); const n0 = m.active().features.length; await m.actions.undo(); await sleep(300); const n1 = m.active().features.length; await m.actions.redo(); await sleep(300); const r = await run(['await mm.suppress("Base", true);', 'const sup = mm.features().find((f) => f.name === "Base").suppressed;', 'await mm.suppress("Base", false);', 'await mm.renameFeature("Base", "Plate");', 'const n = mm.features().length;', 'return { sup, renamed: mm.features().some((f) => f.name === "Plate"), n };']); const bad = await run(['await mm.extrude("NoSuchSketch", 5);']); const bad2 = await run(['await mm.sketch("top", [{ blob: [1] }]);']); return JSON.stringify({ undo: n0 - n1, value: r.value, bad: bad.ok === false && /NoSuchSketch/.test(bad.error) && bad.line === 1, bad2: bad2.ok === false && /blob/.test(bad2.error) }); })()

name: api: configurations and custom properties from a macro; the task pane lists the custom properties and edits them
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const run = async (lines) => m.macro.runMacro(lines.join('\n'), { name: 'api-test.mmjs' }); const r = await run(['await mm.addConfiguration("Small");', 'await mm.useConfiguration("Small");', 'const active = mm.configurations().find((c) => c.active)?.name;', 'await mm.useConfiguration(null);', 'await mm.setCustomProperty("Vendor", "ACME");', 'await mm.setCustomProperty("Finish", "Anodised");', 'return { active, none: mm.configurations().every((c) => !c.active), vendor: mm.customProperty("Vendor"), props: mm.properties().custom };']); m.actions.select([]); await sleep(300); const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.cprop-row').length; const key = q('[data-prop="cprop.1.key"]'); key.value = 'Surface'; key.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(300); q('[data-cprop-add]').click(); await sleep(300); const after = Object.keys(m.active().customProperties); q('[data-cprop-del="0"]').click(); await sleep(300); return JSON.stringify({ value: r.value, rows, after, left: Object.keys(m.active().customProperties) }); })()

name: api: events — change, selection and document handlers run until removed; a failing handler is logged, not fatal
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const run = async (lines) => m.macro.runMacro(lines.join('\n'), { name: 'api-test.mmjs' }); const r = await run(['window.__ev = { change: 0, selection: 0, document: 0 };', 'mm.on("change", () => { window.__ev.change++; });', 'mm.on("selection", () => { window.__ev.selection++; });', 'mm.on("document", () => { window.__ev.document++; });', 'mm.on("change", () => { throw new Error("handler boom"); });', 'return mm.events().length;']); await sleep(100); m.actions.change('op.edit', () => { m.active().description = 'by event test'; }); await sleep(100); m.actions.select([{ kind: 'doc' }]); await sleep(100); const ev1 = { ...window.__ev }; const logged = m.macro.state().log.some((l) => /handler boom/.test(l.text)); m.macro.mm.off('change'); m.actions.change('op.edit', () => { m.active().description = 'again'; }); await sleep(100); return JSON.stringify({ events: r.value, change: ev1.change, selection: ev1.selection >= 1, logged, afterOff: window.__ev.change === ev1.change }); })()

name: api: an assembly from a macro — two components placed, interference found, then moved apart
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const run = async (lines) => m.macro.runMacro(lines.join('\n'), { name: 'api-test.mmjs' }); const r = await run(['const part = mm.documents().find((d) => d.kind === "part").name;', 'await mm.addAssembly("Plates");', 'const a = await mm.insertComponent(part, [0, 0, 0]);', 'const b = await mm.insertComponent(part, [30, 0, 0]);', 'const hits = await mm.interference();', 'await mm.moveComponent(b, [200, 0, 0]);', 'const after = await mm.interference();', 'return { n: mm.components().length, hits: hits.length, volume: hits[0]?.volume > 0, after: after.length, pos: mm.components()[1].position };']); m.macro.mm.off('selection'); m.macro.mm.off('document'); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, err: r.error ?? null, value: r.value }); })()
